rationale: Shirley brings ML research and full-stack development experience (Python, TypeScript) that could directly support Stiven's work on computer vision and ML infrastructure for surgical AR navigation at Braillic. As a CMU graduate student building AI productivity tools, she has the technical depth to collaborate on the kind of AI/CV challenges embedded in ArNav, while Stiven's medtech domain expertise and CTO perspective could expose her to real-world applications beyond her current consumer-AI focus.
intro_message: Shirley Li, meet Stiven Ding — Shirley's background in ML research and full-stack development could be valuable to your computer vision and ML infrastructure work at Braillic, and your surgical AR platform might spark new directions for her AI tooling interests.
